draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.43, the 19th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 2nd of 20 at DE. He lasted until pick 46, well after his grade rank (19th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: John Franklin-Myers. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 8 sacks in 2022, 6th of 19 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the San Francisco 49ers. 47 career games and 20 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2024. Versus the typical Year-3 edge rusher who played: 1.5 sacks against a median of 2.0, below the norm.
